patient_summary.purpose: Immunotherapy after chemotherapy and radiotherapy, aiming to reduce the chance of lung cancer returning or worsening.
patient_summary.schedule: Durvalumab is given on Day 1 every 28 days, for up to 12 months (13 cycles). Treatment may stop earlier after review.

phases.title: Before durvalumab
phases.text: Concurrent chemotherapy and radiotherapy are completed first.

phases.title: Start and continue
phases.text: First dose within 42 days after chemoradiotherapy; then every four weeks.

phases.title: After the course
phases.text: Keep reporting symptoms and follow your monitoring plan.

patient_summary.purpose: Chemotherapy and immunotherapy to help control extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer.
patient_summary.schedule: Every 21 days: atezolizumab and carboplatin on Day 1, etoposide on Days 1–3, for up to four cycles. Maintenance uses atezolizumab alone.
